import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    p=params
    return (p[1] + p[2]*t*t + p[3]*np.log(v) + p[4]*S*np.sqrt(v) + p[5]/v + p[6]*v/(1+v*v)
            + p[7]*C*np.sqrt(v) + p[8]*x + p[9]*x*x)
